scenario_text:
We're standing up the tier behind a high-traffic content site. Roughly 200
concurrent users. Most reads should be served from cache; Postgres holds only
about 8 GB of canonical content and gets relatively little traffic. Host is
6 GB RAM, 4 vCPU. Cache hit rate matters more than durability for the cached
data itself. Standard security hygiene please.
